message: 最大の敵
It was quiet.
No, it wasn't merely quiet.
The treetops didn't stir in the slightest, not even the faintest breeze blowing.
Despite the trees rustling, it was eerie.

name: Azel
message: 「You were receiving special treatment.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Precisely why.」

name: Azel
message: 「So that's how it is.」

name: Pasta
message: 「What are you talking about, nya?」

name: Soltia
message: 「It's nothing that matters even if you don't understand.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Explain it to me, nya! Meow, meow, meow!」

name: Virus
message: 「Explain it to her.」

name: Soltia
message: 「...Sigh.」

name: Soltia
message: 「It means we're being let loose on a long leash.」

name: Soltia
message: 「You do know that the ones running the academy are the Kujou clan, right?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Is that so, nya?」

name: Azel
message: 「How foolish.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Wh-nya-t did you say!」

name: Soltia
message: 「The Kujou clan has deep ties to the Demon King. Moreover, even though they aren't angels, that clan possesses the power to fight us Demons.」

name: Soltia
message: 「They also know that Re-Crea is approaching. That's why they anticipated that someone would interfere in that land.」

name: Soltia
message: 「However, they don't know who we are or what we're after.」

name: Soltia
message: 「They're letting us roam free in order to figure that out. Both me and you.」

name: Pasta
message: 「D-does that mean we've been found out, nya?! That's terrible, nya!」

name: Soltia
message: 「It doesn't matter if we're found out.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Is that right, nya?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Even if the Kujou forces join hands with the Student Council, they're beneath notice. They're at a level where it's doubtful they could even defeat your subordinates.」

name: Soltia
message: 「In other words, thanks to them being overly clever for their own good, we were able to walk right in without a hitch」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya-thing to worry about, huh? I got scared for nothing, nya」

name: Soltia
message: 「You look like you want to say something」

name: Azel
message: 「The Student Council has not been informed that you are demons」

name: Soltia
message: 「......Even if that's the case, it isn't a problem」

name: Virus
message: 「Meaning it might be the Demon King, huh」

name: Soltia
message: 「That's just an old legend」

name: Azel
message: 「However, there is a possibility the enemy believes they can oppose us without the Student Council's fighting strength」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya... so... you mean there's an enemy other than the Kujou and the Student Council, nya? And it might be the Demon King, nya?」

name: Azel
message: 「Indeed」

name: Pasta
message: 「Even if that enemy shows up, Pasta will beat 'em up, nya! Even if the Demon King shows up, I'll defeat 'em, nya!」

name: Virus
message: 「I'm counting on you, Pasta」

name: Pasta
message: 「Ehehe. I'll do my best, nya!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Still, does the Demon King even exist, nya?」

name: Virus
message: 「Oh, he exists」

name: Azel
message: 「We have no choice but to consider the possibility」

name: Soltia
message: 「Oh my? I thought you didn't believe in him?」

name: Azel
message: 「During the previous Re-Crea, it was confirmed that a member of the Kujou family made contact with an entity calling itself the Demon King」

name: Soltia
message: 「Since there are sources from separate worlds, you decided to believe it too, is that it?」

name: Azel
message: 「I do not believe it completely」

name: Soltia
message: 「No records proving the Demon King's existence remain in Heaven. That was the case, wasn't it?」

name: Soltia
message: 「However, while few in number, records proving his existence do exist in the Demon World. According to them, every appearance of the Demon King coincides with Re-Crea」

name: Azel
message: 「There is far too little information」

name: Soltia
message: 「Of course, I can't say for certain whether the Demon King appeared during every Re-Crea」

name: Soltia
message: 「It's possible they did appear and it simply wasn't recorded, or there may have been times when the Demon King didn't appear at all」

name: Soltia
message: 「However, it's certain that there is a significant connection between the Demon King and the Re-Crea」

name: Soltia
message: 「And there are a few written accounts of the Demon King quelling the Re-Crea, too. If that's true, then the Demon King is our greatest threat」

name: Azel
message: 「Impossible」

name: Soltia
message: 「Yet the fact remains that the Three Realms still exist even after enduring several large-scale Re-Creas」

name: Soltia
message: 「Still. There's no telling whether the Demon King will appear this time」

name: Virus
message: 「They'll appear」
There was certainty in that voice.

name: Azel
message: 「Even so, the world will be remade」

name: Soltia
message: 「Quite confident, aren't you」

name: Azel
message: 「It isn't confidence」

name: Azel
message: 「It is the will of our Lord」
